CWE-804.name: Guessable CAPTCHA
CWE-804.original_description: The product uses a CAPTCHA challenge, but the challenge can be guessed or automatically recognized by a non-human actor.
CWE-804.description: The product uses a CAPTCHA challenge, but the challenge can be guessed or automatically recognized by a non-human actor. An automated attacker could bypass the intended protection of the CAPTCHA challenge and perform actions at a higher frequency than humanly possible, such as launching spam attacks. There can be several different causes of a guessable CAPTCHA: An audio or visual image that does not have sufficient distortion from the unobfuscated source image. A question is generated with a format that can be automatically recognized, such as a math question. A question for which the number of possible answers is limited, such as birth years or favorite sports teams.
